title: A Summer for the Garden
author: Ada Oyelaran
blurb: Casper Dunmore, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
